bills.title: Export Control Amendment (Ending Live Sheep Exports by Sea) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-05-30.6.1): > *That the [Export Control Amendment (Ending Live Sheep Exports by Sea) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7203) be referred to the Standing committee on Agriculture for consideration and an advisory report at 8 October 2024.* This means that it failed and the bill won't be referred to the committee. It was introduced by Maranoa MP [David Littleproud](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/maranoa/david_littleproud) (Nationals).
